semiconductor_relevance: High — GreaTech Substrates Co., Ltd. specializes in the packaging substrate industry, which is critical for semiconductor assembly and integration.
summary: GreaTech Substrates Co., Ltd. is a leading player in the packaging substrate sector, established in 2021 as a subsidiary of Shennan Circuits Co., Ltd. With production bases in Guangzhou, Shenzhen, and Wuxi, GTS focuses on enhancing technical capabilities and product quality to support the global semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.China: GTS is headquartered in Guangzhou and has production facilities in Guangzhou, Shenzhen, and Wuxi.
